prompt: We are a 400-employee Saudi retailer, not part of critical national infrastructure. Which NCA cybersecurity controls apply to us?
assertions: Identifies NCNICC-1:2025, the Non-CNI Private Sector Entities Cybersecurity Controls, adopted December 28, 2025
Applies size-based applicability: over 250 employees (or over SAR 200M revenue) places the company in Category A
States Category A faces 3 main components, 22 sub-components and 65 mandatory controls
States no compliance deadline has been published and the NCA may assess compliance at any time without notice
Describes the component coverage: cybersecurity governance, cybersecurity defence, and third-party and cloud computing
